messages:
Elaine: Heads-up — Concord (hardware + secrets vendor) reached out to bundle their HSM with our Marketplace listing. They want a coordinated onboarding + joint announcement. Can we do a quick checklist here?
Raj: +1. Need to map KMS key flow and HSM attestation requirements. I can take the KMS/HSM tech writeup.
Marta: I'll loop in Legal for the embargo + co-marketing terms. timeline?
Elaine: Ideally demo + marketplace listing in ~4 weeks. Marketing wants a 2-week embargo before public.
Sylvia: For SCIM/SSO: Concord will push SCIM provisioning and SAML IdP metadata. We need sample mappings and attribute contract.
John (PM): Marketing draft and one-pager needed. I'll sketch the joint announcement outline and product bullets.
Raj: For HSM -> we need to confirm: do they do BYOK or do we host keys? Also attestation method (TPM vs PKCS11).
Sylvia: Concord prefers customer-managed keys (BYOK). We'll map SCIM attrs as follows:
```
scim.mapping:
  externalId -> id
  userName -> email
  name.givenName -> first_name
  name.familyName -> last_name
  groups -> groups
```
Elaine: Perfect. Marta — can you confirm any NDAs or embargo windows with Legal by EOD?
Marta: On it. I'll ask Legal to check co-marketing terms and export control for HSM firmware. ETA 24h.
deploy-bot: meeting scheduled: #partnerships 2025-07-22 13:00 PT — Zoom link created.
John (PM): For the marketplace listing, we need: 1) logo + partner blurb, 2) technical integration doc, 3) compliance badges (SOC2/ISO), 4) demo video. Who owns each?
Raj: I own the tech doc + integration checklist. Sylvia will own SCIM/SAML snippets.
Sylvia: Yep — I'll produce SAML metadata example and a short troubleshooting FAQ.
Marta: Legal will flag any copy changes. Also need to confirm partner legal sign-off before publish.
Elaine: Action items: Raj -> KMS/HSM flow and attestation doc, Sylvia -> SCIM/SAML samples, John -> announcement draft + marketplace template, Marta -> legal & embargo. Check back in this thread after the meeting. :thumbsup:
